name: 38-t41-railed-reserve-unknown
incident: 2026-10-05 Vanhua T55A (T41, open-tx-isp): hr=-1 on every silent probe
description: Scenario 37 without GetAeExprInfo (older OpenIMP, or the call failing): only the /proc dump, whose AeMaxAGain (61.96x sensor maximum) is not the AE's ceiling and is therefore not used. The reserve stays unknown, so the r=1.00 silent probe cannot tell the rail from a lit room and escalates to the audible probe, rationed by probe_min_gap_s. Pins the fallback: unknown is never taken as reserve.

expect_log: AE reserve is unknown - cannot tell a lit room from a railed meter
